Training / Learning Resources update · v3.2 · 1 October 2026

This update supersedes baseline resource behavior and retains the v3.1 trainee registration changes. New learning resources save a required Project → Training Plan association with their file bytes. Common resources reuse the same stored file across plans/projects. Each resource link has its own existing-batch availability decision.

Screen journeys

  • Admin: Learning resources → Permissions & approved formats → choose trainer → grant/revoke upload → review format allowlist → save.
  • Admin/permitted Trainer: Upload & link resource → name → project → dependent Training Plan Code/name → file → optional common publication/request → save actual file bytes and association. Empty project/plan, unapproved formats and failed storage keep the form open.
  • Trainer: optionally request common reuse at upload or later. Admin: review resource → Publish as common → confirm. Pending publication remains project-only.
  • Admin: Link to another plan → project → plan → optionally include existing batches → save. Duplicate or cross-project non-common link is blocked.
  • Admin: Batch availability → inspect links and matching batch codes → Include existing batches → confirm. New learning links use this decision rather than global propagation.
  • Trainer/trainee: view available resources for assigned batch; Open/download retrieves retained file bytes. Missing bytes, out-of-date forms or unlinked access show explicit errors.

Business clarification required

Confirm publication authority/approval/rejection, permitted linking roles, exact video/multimedia allowlist and size limits, resource availability date/day rules, propagation to completed batches and assessment history, removal/versioning/reversal and grant scope/expiry.

Prototype assumptions

Trainer request → central Admin publication is a proposed approval workflow. MP4/WEBM are initial demo video formats. Admin review-approved extensions demonstrate other approved multimedia. Materials use immediate access once their link applies until project end; forms retain assigned-day gating. Include existing batches defaults off and can be explicitly enabled by Admin. Trainer grants are per-user; baseline global grant is a fallback only when no individual setting exists. Existing baseline links retain their review policy. Historical propagation has no automatic reversal. The browser does not enforce production security.

Suggested UX improvements

Keep project-dependent plan selection, permission management, common publication status, linked plan codes, matching batch visibility and field-level errors together. Production may add approval queues/version history after business decisions.

Persistence and verification

Actual file bytes persist in IndexedDB; metadata, links, grants and extension policy persist in localStorage in the same browser/site. Clearing site data deletes them. Browser quota and missing bytes produce errors. Extensions are checked, not file contents or malware. Model/action tests use a file-store fixture; actual browser IndexedDB, responsive layout and playback/download checks remain unverified. Server must enforce permissions and project/plan ACLs, approval/versioning, file allowlists/content checks, storage transactions and audit.
